trackers.tracking_accuracy: best performance stated for lenses under 200mm per manufacturer/reviewer guidance

SV503 line also sold in 80mm (f/7, 560mm FL) and 102mm (714mm FL) apertures per SVBony/Amazon listings; ED doublet/quadruplet designs depending on variant. Field-flattener sold separately for some versions.
Triplet APO with ED center element, fully multi-coated. An 80mm f/6 SV550 variant is also sold per SVBony's product listings.

astro_cameras.notes: Back-illuminated, 12-bit ADC, max frame rate 47fps at full res, exposure range 32us-2000s, full well 40Ke, QE peak 91%. Popular budget-to-mid DSO/dual-purpose camera for small-aperture refractors.

Back-illuminated square-format sensor (no need to rotate camera to fit targets), two-stage TEC cooling to -35C below ambient, 80% peak QE, 50,000e full well, 14-bit depth, zero amp-glow. Common recommendation for small APO refractors like the RedCat/FRA400 class.
14-stop dynamic range, 73ke full well capacity, 80% peak QE. A standard step-up 'serious' DSO camera for intermediate imagers pairing with larger APO refractors.

Planetary-oriented camera: 93 FPS at full resolution (stated as 55% faster than the IMX178-based predecessor's 60fps), 91% peak QE, 12ke full well. High frame rate suits lucky-imaging planetary/lunar work.
Larger-format, high-full-well (47Ke) camera; suited to both planetary/lunar (high frame rate) and lighter DSO work given the 1/1.2-inch sensor size.

mounts.tracking_accuracy: approx 0.6 arcsec RMS guided (calm-night figure from a user review, not a manufacturer spec)

AM3N weighs 4.1kg, has built-in Wi-Fi/Bluetooth for phone control without a hand controller, and supports both alt-az (visual) and EQ GoTo (astrophotography) operation. A common step-up mount pairing well with RedCat/FRA400-class refractors.

mounts.tracking_accuracy: <0.3 arcsec RMS periodic error per manufacturer
mounts.notes: Center-balanced design, mount weighs 10 lb, payload 26 lb (~11.8kg), 128x microstep stepper motors (0.17 arcsec resolution), GOTONOVA GoTo with 212,000+ object database, optional iPolar electronic polar scope. Price not found in sources reviewed - left as tier only.

phone_adapters.notes: Three-axis (X/Y/Z) adjustment for centering the phone camera over the eyepiece; metal-spring threaded twist lock accommodates most phones with cases on. Reviewers note some very wide 2-inch eyepieces (e.g. stock 28mm) may not fit the clamp. A 'NexYZ DX' kit variant also exists per Celestron's site.
